news.title: Trader who made $49 million shorting crypto lost $24 million on ether in 12 seconds
news.summary: The Hyperliquid wallet known as pension-usdt.eth was forced out of a 50,000 ETH short as ether surged, with five liquidation orders helping push the price higher during the unwind.

news.title: Live updates: Bitcoin rises to $72,000; ETF inflows of $700 million were largest in months
news.summary: Spot bitcoin ETFs pulled in $517 million and ether funds $189 million on Aug. 19, the strongest daily hauls in months, as a broad rally torched $2.7 billion in bearish bets.

news.title: BitGo secures South Korea virtual asset license, says it's the first global crypto company to do so
news.summary: Backed by Hana Financial Group and SK Telecom, BitGo Korea built a locally registered entity from scratch to serve institutional and enterprise clients, rather than taking the acquisition route.

news.title: Bitcoin breaks out of six-week range, tops $71,000 as $3 billion in shorts get wiped out
news.summary: Six weeks of compression ended in the largest short liquidation since at least 2021, with $3 billion of bearish bets forced to buy back into thin supply.
